produces: Approved customer risk reviews with an audit trail

steps.name: Pull the review list
steps.note: Export from the core system, then clean the file in Excel before I can use it

steps.name: Gather customer documents
steps.note: Documents sit in three systems, so I search each one for every customer

steps.name: Run name screening
steps.note: Most screening hits are false matches, but each one needs a written reason

steps.name: Check against the policy checklist
steps.note: Checklist changes after policy updates and I double check every item to be safe

steps.name: Write the review memo
steps.note: Same structure every time but I type it from scratch

steps.name: Send for checker approval
steps.note: Approvals sit in email for days and I chase them manually

steps.name: Update records and tracker
steps.note: Same details typed into the system and a side tracker

workarounds: Personal Excel tracker of reviews in progress
Saved email templates for chasing approvals
Printing the checklist and ticking by hand
Asking a senior colleague about unclear policy points
Keeping my own notes on common false screening matches

fixes.title: Memo template with fixed sections
fixes.what: Build one Word template with the standard memo sections, and use Copilot to draft the wording from your checklist notes, with no customer names or IDs pasted in.
fixes.catch: Never paste customer data into AI unless your bank has approved it. Review every sentence before filing.

fixes.title: Excel cleanup in one click
fixes.what: Record the cleanup steps once as a saved Power Query, so each new export is cleaned automatically.
fixes.catch: Check the row count matches the original export each time.

fixes.title: Reason codes for false screening matches
fixes.what: Agree a short list of standard reasons for common false matches with your team lead, and pick from it instead of writing each one fresh.
fixes.catch: Reason codes need compliance sign-off before use. Unusual hits still need a full written reason.

fixes.title: Approval queue in Teams
fixes.what: Move checker approvals from email into a shared approval flow, such as Teams Approvals, so pending items and their age are visible to everyone.
fixes.catch: The audit trail must still meet policy. Confirm with compliance and IT before switching.

fixes.title: One document checklist per customer type
fixes.what: Turn the policy checklist into one short checklist per customer type, listing which system holds each document.
fixes.catch: Owner must update it on every policy change, or it becomes a risk instead of a help.

fixes.title: Single source for review status
fixes.what: Retire the personal tracker by using one shared team list as the only place review status is updated.
fixes.catch: Needs the team to agree to update it every time, or status drifts again.

need: Reviews keep piling up at month end and I worry about missing deadlines the regulator expects.
fear: A shortcut that saves time but fails an audit, or customer data ending up somewhere it should not be.
